description: Flood impact analysis in Nairobi and Machakos County, Kenya as of 1 May 2024 is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code: FL20240426KEN, GDACS ID: 1102561 This map illustrates satellite-detected surface waters in Nairobi and Machakos County, Kenya, as observed from a Pléiades image acquired on 1 May 2024 at 11:06 local time (08:06 UTC). Within the analyzed area, about 22 km² of land appears to be flooded. Coverage: Kenya. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are flooding, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2025-11-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
